mapper.select: SELECT seq, title, writer, content, TO_CHAR(regdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS regDate, cnt FROM board ORDER BY seq DESC
SELECT seq, title, writer, content, TO_CHAR(regdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS regDate, cnt FROM board WHERE seq = #{seq}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO board (seq, title, writer, content) VALUES ( (SELECT NVL(MAX(seq), 0) + 1 FROM board), #{title}, #{writer}, #{content} )
